summary: Part 1 of 4 (00:00-04:50) of the 2.0 Fulfillment App (Sellers) training. Pierre walks through the Revibe Fulfillment App web tool: the SKUs available list (eligible SKUs, quantities allowed, price, filter, sort, search, download, SKU detail), then Shipments (list of shipment groups, shipment detail) and how to create a new shipment with a Requests Supplier Form and Request products lines. All 40 frames in the pack were opened and checked against the narration.

terms.meaning: The Revibe web app (titled Revibe - Fulfillment App) where sellers check SKUs, create shipments and follow them.
The list of SKUs eligible to be sent to the Revibe warehouse, with quantities allowed and price.
Quantity of a SKU the seller may send to the warehouse. The trainer says it is based on sales over the last 15 days in UAE and South Africa and on current inventory.
The winning price for a SKU. The trainer says the price on the SKUs list is the same as the buy box price, and that the seller must beat it to send items.
Field on the Request products form (and on shipment request-product rows) labelled Buybox supplier; it shows 608 for SKU 010109-060101, the same value as the SKUs list price.
Seller score which the trainer says affects the buy box price; explained in another video.
Seller price sheet from which SKUs can be selected; explained in another video.
A set of SKUs sent to the Revibe warehouse, shown on the Shipments tab.
Status of a shipment; values seen: Requested, Picked up, Warehouse received, Cancelled.
Individual SKU lines inside a shipment (also a sidebar tab name).
Field on a request product line; values seen: Open (new line, t00278) and Closed (on a Warehouse received line, t00241).
Current payment method: payment after sales. The trainer says a 95% payment at warehouse reception method will be implemented later.
Shipment status shown after the Revibe warehouse has received the shipment (as listed on the Shipments page).

asr_fixes.basis: Screen title reads Revibe - Fulfillment App (frame t00000.jpg).
Company name is spelled Revibe on the screen title (frame t00000.jpg) and in the transcript at 00:00 (Revibe).
Sidebar item reads Inventory exits (frame t00060.jpg).
Sidebar item reads Box request (frame t00060.jpg).
Search field is labelled Search SKUs available (frame t00107.jpg).

unclear.issue: Narration says Revibe {Express?} section on the website. The word Express is not shown on any frame, so this name cannot be confirmed.

Narration says beat the buy box by at least one DRAM. The currency or unit is not shown on screen (prices such as 608 and 607 have no currency label), so the unit cannot be confirmed. It may be a currency name, but this is not in the evidence.
Prices on the SKUs list and the Request products form have no currency shown on screen.

On the SKUs available list (frame t00128.jpg), SKU 980104-000004 (Lightning-To-Headphone-Jack-Adapter-3.5M, quantities allowed 8) shows a Price of -15. The narration says the list shows only SKUs with quantities allowed above zero and that the price is the buy box price; the negative price is not explained.

A new Request products form shows Price -1 before any SKU is chosen (frames t00278 and t00248), labelled The lower you go, the more you sell. The trainer does not say whether -1 is a default value or only a placeholder.

Narration says the SKU is added in the shipment automatically (word marked {automatically,?}). The screen shows only the SKU selection in the form, so whether lines are added automatically is not confirmed.

In the Related Request_products tables (frames t00234 and t00238) the table is scrolled horizontally and some columns are cut off. In t00234 one row shows Quantity Sent 3, Price 1,201 and Total price 2,402, which does not match Quantity Sent x Price, so the column mapping cannot be fully confirmed from the frames.
Narration says the price depends on the seller score (explained in another video). How the score changes the price is not explained in this part of the video.

outdated.signal: Trainer says a new payment method, 95% payment at warehouse reception, will be implemented. It was not shown on screen and is not confirmed as live; the 100% - After sales method is the only one shown.
